title: proton-drive-cli bridge auth-state payload
description: Success payload of `bridge auth-state`: readiness of the saved browser-fork session. session_invalid means session.json is not a session written by `proton-drive-cli login` (non-blank uid, accessToken, refreshToken and keyPasswordHost, keyPasswordProvider git-credential or pass-cli). session_expired means the access token expired locally; bridge init refreshes it before use. willAttemptNetwork is always false: proton-drive-cli sends no request to the Proton API and refreshes no token for auth-state. keyPasswordAvailable comes from reading the entry through the session's credential provider; pass-cli can contact Proton Pass to do so. errors carries the provider's reason when the key password could not be read.
